skill.displayName: 尉缭子分析法 | Wei Liaozi Strategic Analysis
skill.summary: 尉缭子战略分析法。使用时机：(1) 用户需要结构化战略分析 (2) 想避免冲动决策 (3) 问"值不值得做/先做什么/对手会怎么反应" (4) 商业判断、竞争分析、谈判准备、项目取舍。框架：本质 → 条件 → 得失 → 先后 → 对手，按顺序想，不跳步。

latestVersion.changelog: Removed the old compatibility field name from README examples to avoid ClawHub static-scan false positives. Kept instructions as the documented host-facing field for ClawHub routing integration. Added direct historical route matches and tests for short prompts such as 秦灭亡, 楚汉相争, and 张良韩信与尉缭关系. Bumped the project version to 1.5.2.
